review_evidence: README states the explicit goal of defining the chromatic polynomial of a simple graph and proving elementary theorems about it.
The six primary files contain 14 proposition declarations and 30 declaration-style items, including indicator lemmas, spanning-subgraph results and a chromatic-polynomial evaluation theorem.
This is direct graph-theory formalization and remains retained.
summary: Reviewed ChromaticPolynomial and retain its graph-theoretic chromatic-polynomial definitions and proofs.
